note: Confirmed through a library route: the Open Library record gives Mind is a Myth: Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti, Smriti Books, 2003 (distributor New Age Books), xxvii, 159 pp.; PhilArchive gives New Delhi: Smriti Books, eds. Terry Newland & Sunita Pant Bansal (2003). ISBN 8187967102 / 9788187967101. A Biblio listing also shows a 2002 paperback date, a 2005 Smriti reprint and a Mahesh Bhatt foreword, so other printings exist.

Found with an ISBN search: a Biblio listing gives the Smriti Books, New Delhi first Indian edition, ISBN 8187967064 / 9788187967064, dated 1 Jan 2001, 126 pp., ed. Ellen J. Chrystal, foreword Mahesh Bhatt. India Club and Bagchee list it too. These are bookseller records only (no library record), and 1 Jan is probably a placeholder day. Original edition: Plover Press, New York, 1997.

Found with an ISBN search: a Biblio listing gives the Smriti Books, New Delhi edition, ISBN 8187967080 / 9788187967088, dated 5 Feb 2002, eds. J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty, Antony Paul Noronha and Sunita Pant Bansal. Another listing gives Psb Enterprises, 31 Dec 2005 (likely a reprint or distributor record). Earlier edition: Akshaya, Bangalore, 1992. These are bookseller records only.

Found with an ISBN search: the Goodreads editions list gives Thought is Your Enemy: Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti, Winsome Books India, paperback, 123 pp., published 1 Dec 2009, ISBN 8188043621 / 9788188043620. No second listing (library or bookseller) confirms it, so it stays T. Original edition: Sowmya Publications, Bangalore, 1991, eds. Antony Paul Frank Noronha and J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty.

Searched for the publisher again: the WELL bibliography still gives only 'Second Edition: 1992' (first edition 1982, ed. Rodney Arms). Its Bangalore address belongs to the third edition (Sahasranama Prakashana, Vidyaranyapura). No result names Dinesh Publications or Akshaya Prakashana as the 1992 publisher, so the year is supported and the publisher is not. Related: Smriti Books 2005 printing, ISBN 9788187967095 (Goodreads editions).

Searched for ISBN 9788028286125 with the title: no listing matched. The only Sharp Ink hit had a different number (9788028375997, an unrelated book). Sharp Ink's 2023 U.G. e-books are confirmed in general, but this ISBN and title are still unconfirmed. Other e-book editions of the title: E-Artnow 9788027341443; 4064066407667 (decitre).

Confirmed: the WELL bibliography lists 'STOPPED IN OUR TRACKS -- (Second Series) -- UG-ANECDOTES, COMMENTS AND REFLECTIONS: from the Notebooks of K. Chandrasekhar. Translated from the Telugu by J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty. Published by The Firsthand Publications. Bangalore, India. 2010.' A later reissue under ISBN 9788196985509 ('Series Two') appears on AbeBooks; it may be the Motilal Banarsidass line, whose 'Anecdotes of UG - Palm Springs and Switzerland' (ISBN 9788196985547, 2024, 367 pp.) is the third volume. Whether the newer ISBN is the same text as the 2010 edition is not confirmed.

Searched another route, tying it to Australia/ABC: the only Australian TV result is Jiddu Krishnamurti's 1970 'This Day Tonight' interview (not U.G.). The 1986 programme and broadcaster are still unidentified; the year rests on the WELL tribute and the ligotti.net thread.

The same 'Lectures Beyond Beyond' channel search found no channel or video; 6deGa7wkidw is still unverified.
